name: 99 - API - Manage Workflow Error Events - Corrected V2

parameters.query:
WITH request_data AS (
    SELECT
        $1::TEXT AS action,
        NULLIF($2::TEXT, '') AS clinic_name,
        NULLIF($3::BIGINT, 0) AS error_event_id,
        NULLIF($4::TEXT, '') AS error_fingerprint,
        $5::TEXT AS status_filter,
        NULLIF($6::TEXT, '') AS severity_filter,
        NULLIF($7::TEXT, '') AS actor_name,
        NULLIF($8::TEXT, '') AS resolution_note,
        $9::INTEGER AS result_limit
),

scope AS (
    SELECT
        request.*,
        clinic.id AS clinic_id
    FROM request_data request
    LEFT JOIN clinics clinic
        ON clinic.name = request.clinic_name
       AND clinic.is_active = TRUE
),

target_error AS (
    SELECT error_event.*
    FROM workflow_error_events error_event
    CROSS JOIN scope scope_row
    WHERE (
            (
                scope_row.error_event_id IS NOT NULL
                AND error_event.id =
                    scope_row.error_event_id
            )
            OR (
                scope_row.error_event_id IS NULL
                AND scope_row.error_fingerprint IS NOT NULL
                AND error_event.error_fingerprint =
                    scope_row.error_fingerprint
            )
          )
      AND (
            scope_row.clinic_name IS NULL
            OR error_event.clinic_id =
               scope_row.clinic_id
          )
    ORDER BY error_event.id
    LIMIT 1
),

updated_error AS (
    UPDATE workflow_error_events error_event
    SET
        status = CASE scope_row.action
            WHEN 'acknowledge'
                THEN 'acknowledged'
            WHEN 'resolve'
                THEN 'resolved'
            WHEN 'ignore'
                THEN 'ignored'
            WHEN 'reopen'
                THEN 'open'
            ELSE error_event.status
        END,

        acknowledged_by = CASE
            WHEN scope_row.action = 'acknowledge'
                THEN scope_row.actor_name
            WHEN scope_row.action = 'reopen'
                THEN NULL
            ELSE error_event.acknowledged_by
        END,

        acknowledged_at = CASE
            WHEN scope_row.action = 'acknowledge'
                THEN NOW()
            WHEN scope_row.action = 'reopen'
                THEN NULL
            ELSE error_event.acknowledged_at
        END,

        resolved_by = CASE
            WHEN scope_row.action IN (
                'resolve',
                'ignore'
            )
                THEN scope_row.actor_name
            WHEN scope_row.action = 'reopen'
                THEN NULL
            ELSE error_event.resolved_by
        END,

        resolution_note = CASE
            WHEN scope_row.action IN (
                'resolve',
                'ignore'
            )
                THEN scope_row.resolution_note
            WHEN scope_row.action = 'reopen'
                THEN NULL
            ELSE error_event.resolution_note
        END,

        resolved_at = CASE
            WHEN scope_row.action IN (
                'resolve',
                'ignore'
            )
                THEN NOW()
            WHEN scope_row.action = 'reopen'
                THEN NULL
            ELSE error_event.resolved_at
        END,

        updated_at = NOW()

    FROM scope scope_row
    WHERE error_event.id = (
            SELECT id
            FROM target_error
          )
      AND scope_row.action IN (
            'acknowledge',
            'resolve',
            'ignore',
            'reopen'
          )
    RETURNING error_event.*
),

list_rows AS (
    SELECT
        error_event.id,
        error_event.error_fingerprint,
        error_event.clinic_id,
        error_event.workflow_name,
        error_event.workflow_id,
        error_event.execution_id,
        error_event.node_name,
        error_event.error_type,
        error_event.error_message,
        error_event.severity,
        error_event.retryable,
        error_event.status,
        error_event.occurrence_count,
        error_event.first_occurred_at,
        error_event.last_occurred_at,
        error_event.acknowledged_by,
        error_event.acknowledged_at,
        error_event.resolved_by,
        error_event.resolution_note,
        error_event.resolved_at
    FROM workflow_error_events error_event
    CROSS JOIN scope scope_row
    WHERE scope_row.action = 'list'
      AND (
            scope_row.clinic_name IS NULL
            OR error_event.clinic_id =
               scope_row.clinic_id
          )
      AND (
            scope_row.status_filter = 'all'
            OR error_event.status =
               scope_row.status_filter
          )
      AND (
            scope_row.severity_filter IS NULL
            OR error_event.severity =
               scope_row.severity_filter
          )
    ORDER BY
        CASE error_event.severity
            WHEN 'critical' THEN 1
            WHEN 'error' THEN 2
            ELSE 3
        END,
        error_event.last_occurred_at DESC
    LIMIT (
        SELECT result_limit
        FROM request_data
    )
),

selected_row AS (
    SELECT target_error.*
    FROM target_error
    CROSS JOIN request_data request
    WHERE request.action = 'get'

    UNION ALL

    SELECT updated_error.*
    FROM updated_error
)

SELECT
    CASE
        WHEN request.clinic_name IS NOT NULL
         AND NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM scope
            WHERE clinic_id IS NOT NULL
         )
            THEN FALSE

        WHEN request.action IN (
            'get',
            'acknowledge',
            'resolve',
            'ignore',
            'reopen'
        )
         AND NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM target_error
         )
            THEN FALSE

        ELSE TRUE
    END AS success,

    CASE
        WHEN request.clinic_name IS NOT NULL
         AND NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM scope
            WHERE clinic_id IS NOT NULL
         )
            THEN 'clinic_not_found'

        WHEN request.action IN (
            'get',
            'acknowledge',
            'resolve',
            'ignore',
            'reopen'
        )
         AND NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM target_error
         )
            THEN 'workflow_error_not_found'

        WHEN request.action = 'acknowledge'
            THEN 'workflow_error_acknowledged'

        WHEN request.action = 'resolve'
            THEN 'workflow_error_resolved'

        WHEN request.action = 'ignore'
            THEN 'workflow_error_ignored'

        WHEN request.action = 'reopen'
            THEN 'workflow_error_reopened'

        WHEN request.action = 'get'
            THEN 'workflow_error_loaded'

        ELSE 'workflow_errors_listed'
    END AS result,

    (
        SELECT TO_JSONB(selected_row)
        FROM selected_row
        LIMIT 1
    ) AS error_event,

    COALESCE(
        (
            SELECT JSONB_AGG(
                TO_JSONB(list_rows)
            )
            FROM list_rows
        ),
        '[]'::JSONB
    ) AS error_events,

    COALESCE(
        (
            SELECT COUNT(*)
            FROM list_rows
        ),
        0
    ) AS error_event_count

FROM request_data request;

parameters.content:
## مدیریت خطاهای ثبت‌شده

اقدام‌ها:
- list
- get
- acknowledge
- resolve
- ignore
- reopen

Resolve و Ignore نیازمند توضیح هستند.

اصلاح V2:
- Clinic Not Found دیگر به Scope سراسری تبدیل نمی‌شود.
- Clinic Isolation برای error_event_id و error_fingerprint اعمال می‌شود.
- اولویت OR/AND در target_error اصلاح شده است.
